protocol: Five-fold Paper-v1 LODO with SOH-only supervision. For each fold, four source domains contribute only their unchanged Paper-v1 train and validation partitions. The left-out domain contributes only its unchanged Paper-v1 test partition for zero-shot evaluation. Source test batteries and left-out train/validation batteries are excluded. Model, fixed physical normalizations, optimizer, scheduler, early stopping, and E2-FULL-D hierarchical domain-then-battery sampling are inherited unchanged from E2-FULL-D w/o cycle auxiliary.
